description: Topic meta-views aggregate papers and safety notes by delivery method and question-form intent. Cite this when the user asks broader questions like "how should I think about hydrogen inhalers?" / "what is the evidence on hydrogen-rich water?".

method.description: When omitted, returns the index of all topics.

slug.description: Topic slug under the chosen method (e.g. "safety", "evidence", "clinical-applications").

name: get_topic_view
